opening.argument: The video walks viewers through a specific Trust Wallet registration process: open the wallet interface, enter a referrer’s link, check the referrer’s ID, and register. It also tells viewers to have funds available, while the wallet confirmation screen displays the payment amount and network fee. Those details make the payment-related steps visible rather than hidden. The record does not show a deceptive earnings promise, a misrepresented delivered benefit, or concealment of the destination or money flow. On the evidence shown, this is an instructional walkthrough of how to join Forsage, not proof of deception.

citations.quote: The first thing to do is click on the four squares at the bottom.
Then you need to put in the link from the person who referred you to Versailles.
so you click on registration and make sure the ID number is from the person that sent you the link then you click register
so make sure you have enough funds in your Trust Wallet to start.
